record.reason: SMMBench is an evaluation benchmark for source-distributed multimodal agent memory. Full text focuses on benchmark tasks and evaluation; it does not provide a memory compression, retrieval-latency, token-cost, or serving optimization method, though the linked memory lineage makes the benchmark potentially useful context.
record.title: SMMBench: A Benchmark for Source-Distributed Multimodal Agent Memory
